tour.sidebar.title: Your organizer navigation
tour.sidebar.description: This sidebar is how you move around your organization: overview, events, leaderboards, members, payouts and more. The section you are on is highlighted in green.
tour.overview.title.title: Welcome to your organizer overview
tour.overview.title.description: This is your organization's home base. It gives you a quick read on your activity at a glance.
tour.overview.stats.title: Your headline numbers
tour.overview.stats.description: These tiles summarise your organization, for example how many members and events you have. A fast health check before you dive in.
tour.profile.title.title: Your organization profile
tour.profile.title.description: Manage how your organization appears across the site: its logo, banner, name, description and social links.
tour.profile.images.title: Logo and banner
tour.profile.images.description: Upload the logo and banner that brand your organization's page and events. Drop an image or click to choose a file.
tour.profile.save.title: Save your changes
tour.profile.save.description: Apply any edits you make to the profile. Nothing changes for the public until you save.
tour.events.title.title: Your events
tour.events.title.description: Every tournament and scrim your organization is running lives here. Create new ones and manage the existing ones from this page.
tour.events.create.title: Create an event
tour.events.create.description: Start a new tournament or scrim. A wizard walks you through details, stages, prizes and rules, then publishes it.
tour.events.table.title: Your events list
tour.events.table.description: Each row is one event. Use the row actions to view it, edit it, manage its results and leaderboard, set up groups and rosters, or copy its links.
tour.event-create.title.title: Create a new event
tour.event-create.title.description: This wizard builds a tournament or scrim from scratch for your organization, one step at a time.
tour.event-create.form.title: Work through the steps
tour.event-create.form.description: Each step collects part of the event: details, stages, prize pool, rules and more. Use Next and Back to move between them.
tour.event-create.submit.title: Publish your event
tour.event-create.submit.description: On the final step, create the event to publish it. You can also save it as a draft and finish later.
tour.drafts.title.title: Your draft events
tour.drafts.title.description: Events you started but have not published yet are saved here so you can finish them when you are ready.
tour.drafts.create.title: Start a new event
tour.drafts.create.description: Begin a fresh event from the same wizard. It will appear here as a draft until you publish it.
tour.drafts.table.title: Your drafts list
tour.drafts.table.description: Each row is an unpublished event. Continue editing to reopen it in the wizard, or delete one you no longer need.
tour.event-detail.title.title: Event detail
tour.event-detail.title.description: The hub for a single event. From here you reach everything about it: its settings, registrations, groups and results.
tour.event-detail.edit.title: Edit this event
tour.event-detail.edit.description: Reopen the event in the wizard to change any detail, stage, prize or rule after it has been created.
tour.event-detail.links.title: Linked and qualification events
tour.event-detail.links.description: See how this event connects to others, for example which events qualify teams into it or follow on from it.
tour.event-edit.title.title: Edit event
tour.event-edit.title.description: Change any part of an existing event. Your edits apply once you save them.
tour.event-edit.tabs.title: Edit by section
tour.event-edit.tabs.description: Each tab edits one area of the event: basic info, registered teams, stages and groups, prizes and rules, sponsor and waitlist settings, and publish actions.
tour.event-groups.title.title: Groups and rosters
tour.event-groups.title.description: See who is seeded into which group for this event, and check every team's roster before play begins.
tour.event-groups.search.title: Find a player or team fast
tour.event-groups.search.description: Search by in-game name, team or UID to jump straight to a competitor across all the groups.
tour.event-groups.stages.title: Stages and their groups
tour.event-groups.stages.description: Each card is a stage, broken down into its groups and the teams seeded into them. A quick way to confirm the bracket is set up correctly.
tour.event-leaderboard.title.title: Event leaderboard
tour.event-leaderboard.title.description: View and manage the standings for this event. This is where raw match results become the published ranking.
tour.event-leaderboard.stageTabs.title: Pick a stage
tour.event-leaderboard.stageTabs.descrip: Switch between the event's stages to see the standings for each one.
tour.event-leaderboard.table.title: The standings table
tour.event-leaderboard.table.description: Placements, kills and total points for every competitor. Use the upload and edit controls to enter or correct match results.
tour.leaderboards.title.title: Leaderboards
tour.leaderboards.title.description: Manage the results and standings for all of your organization's events from one place.
tour.leaderboards.search.title: Find an event
tour.leaderboards.search.description: Search your events by name, type or status to quickly locate the one you want to score.
tour.leaderboards.table.title: Your events to score
tour.leaderboards.table.description: Each row is an event you can attach or update a leaderboard for. Open one to upload results manually or by screenshot, configure points, and view or edit standings.
tour.standalone-create.wizard.title: Create a standalone leaderboard
tour.standalone-create.wizard.descriptio: Build a leaderboard that is not tied to a full event. This wizard walks you through the basics, the point system, the match results and a final review before you publish.
tour.standalone-view.view.title: Standalone leaderboard
tour.standalone-view.view.description: View the published standings for this standalone leaderboard. If you manage it, you can also reopen it to edit the results.
tour.members.title.title: Your organization's members
tour.members.title.description: Manage who belongs to your organization and what each person is allowed to do.
tour.members.add.title: Add a sub-organizer
tour.members.add.description: Invite another user into your organization and grant them the permissions they need, for example creating events or uploading results.
tour.members.table.title: The members table
tour.members.table.description: Every member with their role and permissions. Adjust what someone can do, or remove them, from here.
tour.payouts.title.title: Your payouts
tour.payouts.title.description: Track your organization's share of paid-event revenue and keep your bank details up to date so you can be paid out.
tour.payouts.stats.title: Owed and paid at a glance
tour.payouts.stats.description: These cards show how much you are owed and how much has already been paid out to your organization.
tour.payouts.table.title: Your earnings ledger
tour.payouts.table.description: A line for every payout, showing the event, the amount and its status. Your full revenue history in one place.
tour.metrics.title.title: Your metrics
tour.metrics.title.description: Aggregate stats for your organization across events, teams, players, kills and ratings.
tour.metrics.stats.title: Headline metrics
tour.metrics.stats.description: These cards summarise your organization's totals for the selected period. A quick read on how you are performing.
tour.metrics.tabs.title: Dig into the trends
tour.metrics.tabs.description: The tabs break the numbers down further, for example trends over time and per-area breakdowns, so you can spot what is growing.
tour.reviews.title.title: Your reviews
tour.reviews.title.description: See the ratings and feedback players have left on your organization's events.
tour.reviews.events.title: Ratings per event
tour.reviews.events.description: Each event shows its average rating and lets you expand to read the comments. All comments are anonymous to keep feedback honest.
tour.design.title.title: Leaderboard design
tour.design.title.description: Customise how your organization's leaderboards look, for example their colours and logos.
tour.design.manager.title: Manage your designs
tour.design.manager.description: Upload and adjust the design assets applied to your leaderboards. Changes here flow through to your published standings.
tour.blacklists.title.title: Your blacklists
tour.blacklists.title.description: Block a team, and the players on it, from registering for your organization's events. You can also review requests to lift a block.
tour.blacklists.add.title: Blacklist a team
tour.blacklists.add.description: Add a team to your blacklist so it can no longer register for your events. The players on its roster are captured at the same time.
tour.blacklists.table.title: Blacklisted teams
tour.blacklists.table.description: Every team you have blocked, with the roster captured when you added it. Expand a row to see the snapshot, or lift the block when appropriate.
tour.watchlist.manager.title: The shared watchlist
tour.watchlist.manager.description: A community-wide advisory list of suspicious players and teams that admins and organizers share. It is a warning, not a ban, so you know who to watch out for. Search it, or add an entry with a reason.
tour.overlays.list.title: Your live overlays
tour.overlays.list.description: Every event of your organization is listed here. Open one to manage ALL of its broadcast overlays: leaderboard designs with live previews, the countdown timer, the booyah banner, head-to-head comparisons, the broadcast control and the capture key. You only ever see your own events and designs.
tour.overlays-studio.new.title: Create an overlay
tour.overlays-studio.new.description: Make a new overlay from any of your leaderboard designs, or add a countdown timer, a booyah banner, or a head-to-head. Each overlay gets ONE permanent link: add it to OBS, vMix or any streaming software once, and manage everything from here afterwards.
tour.overlays-studio.cards.title: Your saved overlays
tour.overlays-studio.cards.description: Each card is one overlay with a LIVE preview of its real link. Change its design, stage or group, animations or live 3D-room mode, trigger the timer or booyah, pick head-to-head competitors - the same link updates in your streaming software by itself. Rename, duplicate or delete from the card.
tour.overlays-studio.broadcast.title: Broadcast control and media
tour.overlays-studio.broadcast.descripti: Overlays set to 'Follow the broadcast selection' show whatever you pick here - switch the live stage or group without touching your streaming software. Next to it, the broadcast media panel shows which teams and players are missing logos or esport images, lets you flag bad art (the owner is notified) and hide a logo or image for this event only.
